title: Is Organic milk more nutritious than regular milk? | Ask Organic Valley
summary: Dairy co-op farmer explains USDA organic dairy rules on pasture, land transition and antibiotics, and cites higher omega-3 in pasture milk.

assertions.quote: It's required that 30% of an organic cow's feed must come directly from an organically managed pasture at least 120 days of the year.
The land is required to be free of chemical fertilizers, pesticides and herbicides for at least three years
the USDA organic standards require that we cannot use hormones or antibiotics in production of our animals
pasture-raised whole milk had 62 percent higher omega-3 and 18 higher CLAS than conventional milk
more grass in a cow's diet makes for more beneficial fatty acids
